title: Reading is Easy – Tú Ya Sabes
style: 128 BPM Miami Spanglish reggaeton-pop-rap, bilingual EN/ES kid-friendly educational anthem, bright dembow rhythm, warm hand percussion, sunny pop synths, clap-heavy chorus, light auto-tune lead, group call-back vocals, third in spelling/maths/reading trilogy, breezy and confident, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro]
Uno dos tres — vamos
Tú ya sabes, tú ya sabes
Reading is easy, easy, easy

[Verse 1]
Open up the page, see the words start to dance
Letra por letra, dale una chance
Left to right, line by line, take it slow
Tú ya sabes — you already know

[Pre-Chorus]
Spelling was easy, maths was easy
Ahora reading — fácil, breezy
Sound it out, then read it out loud
Di lo que ves — say it proud

[Chorus]
Reading is easy — tú ya sabes
Reading is easy — you already know
A-B-C, uno dos tres
Línea por línea, here we go
Reading is easy — tú ya sabes
Reading is easy — say it slow
The story's yours, the page is yours
Tú ya sabes — you already know

[Verse 2]
Big word, small word, no es problema
Break it down — that's the system, that's the schema
Syllable by syllable, sílaba por sílaba
Keep going, keep going, no te pares ahora

[Pre-Chorus]
Spelling was easy, maths was easy
Ahora reading — fácil, breezy
Sound it out, then read it out loud
Di lo que ves — say it proud

[Chorus]
Reading is easy — tú ya sabes
Reading is easy — you already know
A-B-C, uno dos tres
Línea por línea, here we go
Reading is easy — tú ya sabes
Reading is easy — say it slow
The story's yours, the page is yours
Tú ya sabes — you already know

[Bridge — rap]
Spelling, maths, reading — that's the trilogy
Three easy lessons, the simple symphony
No overthinking, no hard wall in the way
Una palabra, una palabra, every day
MOSOKO — the lesson lands when it's simple
Sound it out, light it up, like a dimple
Tú ya sabes, tú ya sabes
You already know — that's the whole phrase

[Chorus]
Reading is easy — tú ya sabes
Reading is easy — you already know
A-B-C, uno dos tres
Línea por línea, here we go
Reading is easy — tú ya sabes
Reading is easy — say it slow
The story's yours, the page is yours
Tú ya sabes — you already know

[Outro]
Reading is easy
Tú ya sabes
You already know
See you on Tuesday — bring a book
